issues.detail: Do not equate this chronological composite with the complete original diary manuscripts.
Styles/Wesley abridgments are discussed by Dwight; independent comparison remains outstanding.
Sermons and minor writings omitted; cannot count as complete collected works or add its missing sermons to sermon coverage.
Notices shortened, notes relocated; exact impression year unresolved. Complete numbered-letter inventory is a narrower claim.
Retain cuts and modernized expression explicitly; acquire identified Laing history volumes for a fuller comparison.
Editor’s prose and witness knowledge are interwoven with John’s retrospective account.
Two planned chapters omitted; letter excerpts are not complete letters.
Mrs. Paton authored chapter IX letters; preserve source attribution and editorial consent disclosure.
Archive 1889 retained as source metadata; catalog edition date corrected to 1898 from acquired book.
Missionary interpretation, racial classifications and colonial claims are historical testimony, not the catalog’s endorsed descriptions.
